title: MACA directed FP32 FMA realizes distinct rounding and restores ordinary arithmetic, but Cake has no admitted contract
observation: Eight standalone add/FMA RN/RZ/RD/RU interfaces compile to native xcore1000 artifacts and job maca-0a696d72a07a matches8192 finite nonzero-result words. Complete linked functions save/set/restore hardware state through get/sethwreg selector2049; physical register/bitfield decoding is unknown. first_divergence: At7451c2bc complete existing FMA Schedules with maca.fma.rz.f32, maca.fma.rd.f32 or maca.fma.ru.f32 are refused by TARGET_INSTRUCTION_UNSUPPORTED. Manually spelling the measured library functions in the otherwise accepted kernel projection is independently refused by native source admission. Merely extending a Target document leaves registry, emission and source validation gaps.
proposed_change: Reuse existing typed ternary ElementwiseOp.FMA. Register three explicit result-rounding names (RZ/RD/RU), keep Target admission explicit, and place only their library spelling in the MACA emitter. Keep existing nearest-route contract and ordinary arithmetic unchanged; add no global mode, hidden register mutation, layout algebra or new operation. Shared registry/source admission goes through main before MetaX target/emission integration. The source boundary admits only direct three-positional-argument calls of the three spellings on declared mcfatbin, refusing aliases, splats, keyword arguments and other code objects. Require actual Cake-generated native artifacts with mixed arithmetic and edge cases before capability promotion.
principles: P1 reuses lm.fma and explicit instruction names; P2 exposes rounding in the authored contract and generated source; P3 keeps the existing FMA form and adds no second primitive or nearest alias; P4 retains three same-shaped FP32 register operands; P5/P7 keep existing FMA typing/effects and require observable state restoration; P6 requires intended-guard counterexamples, unchanged Target admission snapshots and Corpus expectations, fixed-commit software gates and generated-source successor evidence; P8 binds measured numerics and linked state handling to the captured C550-2 installation.
semantic_boundary: NaN payloads, floating exception flags, exhaustive FP32 inputs and arbitrary runtime versions remain unqualified. State-restoration evidence is observable result equality for the tested compositions, not a proof of every hidden hardware-state bit. Resource queries and instruction API names establish no performance improvement.
promotion_disposition: No capability promotion yet. The measured mechanism justifies a shared admission proposal and explicit MetaX integration; proposed names remain unadmitted on the current platform. Close only after reviewed implementation commit and new Cake-generated device evidence.
